get.description: Grouped statistics using inclusive startDate, exclusive endDate and an IANA timezone. SECOND returns one-second averages and ranges for one selected day. All chart modes are returned together.

numberOfPhysicalPoints.description: Number of physical vertices in this track-data variant's geometry.

track.description: Coordinates [longitude, latitude, altitude, epoch seconds]; missing altitude/time are null.

activeKcal.description: Estimated human energy above standard resting expenditure, for covered intervals only; null when unavailable.

totalKcal.description: Active energy plus standard resting expenditure for the same covered intervals; not a full-track total when coverage is partial.

uncoveredSeconds.description: Known positive duration omitted from the estimate. Missing or invalid timestamps may leave additional unquantifiable gaps.

recordingGapSeconds.description: Known excluded time across explicit recording breaks; included in uncoveredSeconds.

sparseSamplingSeconds.description: Known excluded time between observations too far apart to support motion; included in uncoveredSeconds.

unknownDuration.description: Additional intervals were excluded whose duration cannot be quantified.

dateTimeParams.description: Date-time bounds as ISO 8601 timestamps with an explicit offset, e.g. 2025-06-15T12:00:00+02:00 or 2025-06-15T10:00:00Z. Null or blank bounds are omitted.

timeZone.description: Browser IANA timezone for calendar grouping and year bounds, e.g. Europe/Zurich. Defaults to UTC when omitted.

value.description: Exact raw grp value. Null represents an ungrouped SQL result.

distanceMeters.description: Shortest distance from the activity route to the selected map point, in meters.

matchedMediaCount.description: Number of selected media correlations for the activity.

failedGpsFiles.description: Failed GPS imports, separate from pending work.

checkedAt.description: Time of the last processing status update. Status applies to the whole library, not just this filter.

SegmentHeartRateSummary.description: Time-weighted heart rate over the exact segment, including stops but excluding recording gaps. Null average means no covered time. Repeated visits are weighted by covered seconds.

trackIds.description: Matching filter track IDs, required in both scopes. Media uses the continuous range from their earliest valid start to latest valid end. Empty or undated track selections return no media.
Matching filter track IDs, required in both scopes. Uses the same capture-time range as media trends and map markers.
Matching filter track IDs. Their earliest valid start and latest valid end bound media capture times in both scopes.

bytes.description: Decoded response bytes consumed, including failed responses and route exports; not wire traffic.

syncId.description: Identifies one budgeted cycle across recent and historical lanes.

SegmentCardiacCostSummary.description: Estimated heartbeats per kJ of mechanical work over identical, covered moving intervals. Includes moving coasting intervals; not a measure of metabolic efficiency.

wattsPerBpm.description: Average estimated power in watts divided by time-weighted average BPM over the same covered moving intervals. Equals 1000 / (60 * beatsPerKj); higher W/bpm corresponds to lower beats/kJ. Unavailable under the same coverage and minimum-work rules.

coveragePercent.description: Percentage of observed moving time with both usable energy and heart-rate coverage.

rawCoordinates.description: Coordinates [longitude, latitude, altitude, epoch seconds]; missing altitude/time are null.

canonicalCoordinates.description: Coordinates [longitude, latitude, altitude, epoch seconds]; missing altitude/time are null.

movingAverageBpm.description: Mean of recorded samples during GPS movement (at least 0.5 km/h), excluding detected stops and GPS intervals longer than 60 seconds. Absent when no samples qualify.

minimumBpm.description: Lowest individual recorded sample within the track time range, including stops.

maximumBpm.description: Highest individual recorded sample within the track time range, including stops.

distanceMeters.description: Complete traveled distance from the attempt start; null after unsupported path coverage.

powerWatts.description: Display power from the full-track trailing window (60 seconds for walking/hiking, 30 seconds otherwise), averaged within chart buckets. Null during warm-up or unsupported coverage.

maximumPowerWatts.description: Maximum instantaneous estimated power over the exact full-density segment; independent of chart point count and display averaging.

distanceMeters.description: Complete traveled distance from the attempt start; null after unsupported path coverage.

capturedAt.description: Unadjusted authoritative capture time: EXIF GPS time when available, otherwise DateTimeOriginal.

adjustedCapturedAt.description: Capture time used for activity matching after applying the camera offset when applicable.

appliedCameraOffsetSeconds.description: Offset added to DateTimeOriginal in seconds. Zero when EXIF GPS time is authoritative.

timeSource.description: Metadata field used as the authoritative capture time.

originalLat.description: Original EXIF GPS latitude. Null when the media has no embedded GPS position.

originalLng.description: Original EXIF GPS longitude. Null when the media has no embedded GPS position.

routeLat.description: Latitude on the matched activity route at the adjusted capture time.

routeLng.description: Longitude on the matched activity route at the adjusted capture time.

resolvedLat.description: Latitude selected for display after applying user, EXIF, and track precedence.

resolvedLng.description: Longitude selected for display after applying user, EXIF, and track precedence.

manualLat.description: User-assigned latitude. Null when no manual position exists.

manualLng.description: User-assigned longitude. Null when no manual position exists.

positionOrigin.description: Origin of the resolved display position.

estimatedPosition.description: True only when the media position is inferred from the activity route.

ambiguousMatch.description: True when more than one eligible activity overlapped the adjusted capture time.

preview.description: True when this row is an unsaved camera-offset preview.

trackPointPosition.description: Fractional position in the canonical point-index sequence. The point ID refers to a nearby sample.

recordingGapSinceLastTriggerPoint.description: Recorded path coverage is incomplete; endpoint elapsed time can still be available.

timeInSecSinceLastTriggerPoint.description: Elapsed seconds, including stops; unavailable when timing status is not AVAILABLE.

metadataVersion.description: UI metadata schema version. Only version 2 is supported.

paramGroups.description: Parameter groups keyed by group id.

params.description: Parameter metadata keyed by SQL parameter name.

resolvedFilterRef.description: Resolved filter template ref used to load options.

widget.description: Widget used to edit this parameter.

optional.description: Whether the parameter may be left blank.

originFilterRef.description: Template filter where this effective parameter metadata was defined.

relation.description: Relationship between the selected filter and the parameter metadata origin.

optionsSource.description: Metadata source for widgets that need selectable options.
